title: Hattorf to Jobst Hermann von Ilten, 7 Nov 1697, code A, GWLB Hannover Ms XXIII 1245:4 (catalogue 346)

documents.route: J. E. von Hattorf (Hannover) to J. H. von Ilten

plaintext.source: contemporary decipherment in the recipient's office

transcription.source: GWLB Kitodo master images (public domain), read in crops
transcription.notes: Clear letter with code runs, every run glossed over the groups; code A.

system.summary: A numeric syllabic nomenclator, code A (groups 15 to about 505), with homophones (et = 237/238) and a null (62).
system.notes: Groups separated by dots; code runs embedded in clear French. No key is known; values come from the interlinear glosses. Code B of 1705-06 (targets/ilten1705) is a different code.

prior_solution.where: Interlinear decipherments on the letters themselves (GWLB); Kalliope notes 'Dechiffrierter Brief' on each record.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5.5 and posed the problem with /goal, pasting the catalogue entry. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Kalliope SRU search 'Ilten dechiffriert': six items; the record notes read 'Dechiffrierter Brief' (deciphered), not 'not deciphered' as the catalogue had it.
Found Parts IV and VII of the Receuil de Lettres a J. H. d'Ilten in the GWLB Kitodo library (POST search), mapped folios to physical images through the METS files, fetched the 17 leaves.
Transcribed letter A: clear text, 74 code groups and the interlinear glosses, from crops of the master images (with letters B-D, now ilten1705).
Built a table of every group with every gloss it carries (tables.py): no contradictions; code A told apart from code B; 62 identified as a null.
Read letter A from the glosses: the Elector wants discord sown between Kolbe and Barfus at Berlin (1697). Every group glossed.

Split under the one-key rule: letters B, C, D (code B, 1705-06) moved to ilten1705 with their ciphertexts and transcriptions; this entry keeps letter A in code A; tables.py rerun on A alone (74 groups, 57 distinct, 0 unglossed).

outcome.method_basis: Every code run of the 1697 letter carries a contemporary interlinear decipherment; the work transcribed it and checked it against the recurrence of each group.
outcome.fraction_read_source: ciphertext_A.txt and letter_A_1697.txt: 74 code groups, all glossed (tables.py)
outcome.notes: Catalogue premise corrected: Kalliope's 'Dechiffrierter Brief' means deciphered. No key for code A. Split on 14 Oct 2026: code B (letters B-D) is ilten1705.

credits.note: interlinear decipherments on every code run (recipient's office)
